scenario: 今天的个性化赛道有两条线。一条是把推荐里的成本和信号算清楚。Meta 的 ROO 把同一次请求的多条曝光并成一条样本，省下重复计算去换更大的用户模型，ShopMind 给模拟用户加上随浏览变化的心理状态，再把学到的心理状态用到真实的 CTR 预估上。另一条是让个性化预测讲得清、有保证。有人让 LLM 把冗长的反事实删除清单总结成一句偏好，有人证明特征交叉会让可证明的解释变难。另有两篇用药推荐分别控制处方的相互作用和漏药的严重度，一篇评分模型检查缺失回答会不会推翻当前预测。

papers.title: Request-Only Optimization for Recommendation Systems
papers.authors: Liang Guo, Wei Li, Lucy Liao, Huihui Cheng, Rui Zhang
papers.abstract: Deep Learning Recommendation Models (DLRMs) represent one of the largest machine learning applications on the planet. Industry-scale DLRMs are trained with petabytes of recommendation data to serve billions of users every day. To utilize the rich user signals in the long user history, DLRMs have been scaled up to unprecedented complexity, up to trillions of floating-point operations (TFLOPs) per example. This scale, coupled with the huge amount of training data, necessitates new storage and training algorithms to efficiently improve the quality of these complex recommendation systems. In this paper, we present a Request-Only Optimizations (ROO) training and modeling paradigm. ROO simultaneously improves the storage and training efficiency as well as the model quality of recommendation systems. We holistically approach this challenge through co-designing data (i.e., request-only data), infrastructure (i.e., request-only based data processing pipeline), and model architecture (i.e., request-only neural architectures). Our ROO training and modeling paradigm treats a user request as a unit of the training data. Compared with the established practice of treating a user impression as a unit, our new design achieves native feature deduplication in data logging, consequently saving data storage. Second, by de-duplicating computations and communications across multiple impressions in a request, this new paradigm enables highly scaled-up neural network architectures to better capture user interest signals, such as Generative Recommenders (GRs) and other request-only friendly architectures.

papers.summary: 推荐模型的训练样本通常按曝光来切。一次请求给用户下发好几条内容，每条曝光就是一条样本，同一个用户的特征和长行为序列被原样复制好几份。Meta 统计了自家三个产品，每次请求平均有 4 到 7 条曝光。ROO 把同一次请求的所有曝光打包成一条样本，用户侧特征只存一份、只算一遍。省下的算力可以直接拿去加大用户侧模型。在召回模型上，按曝光训练的 HSTU 要多花 6.8 倍算力才换来的离线收益，改成按请求训练后，每条样本的算力几乎没增加就能拿到。==长序列模型训练贵，很大一块贵在重复算同一个用户==。

papers.title: From Counterfactual Edits to Human Narratives: LLM-Driven Interpretations for Recommender System Explanations
papers.authors: Vojtech Cahlik, Amir Reza Mohammadi, Rodrigo Alves, Pavel Kordik, Eva Zangerle
papers.abstract: Recommender systems increasingly influence what users discover and consume online, yet the decision logic behind their outputs often remains opaque. Counterfactual explanation (CFX) methods provide an effective way to show which changes to a user's interaction history would alter a recommendation. In recommendation settings, however, CFXs often require many edits, producing long, low-level lists that are hard for users to interpret. Moreover, most evaluations emphasize edit counts while largely overlooking whether the resulting CFXs are coherent and actionable for users. We argue that this gap between generating valid CFXs and communicating model behavior stems from the lack of user-centered abstraction and limited qualitative evaluation. To bridge this gap, we investigate large language models as mediators that summarize raw CFX interaction edit lists into concise natural language explanations describing higher-level preference patterns. We optimize these mediators for correctness, informativeness, and linguistic quality through preference optimization, and evaluate the resulting explanations with human-calibrated metrics derived from separate human-labeled datasets. On the MovieLens-1M dataset, across multiple counterfactual generators and language models, the resulting summaries achieve high overall linguistic quality, while the strongest semantic results are obtained with high-success CFX methods such as ACCENT and SPINRec. Direct Preference Optimization improves the semantic metrics in almost all evaluated settings.
papers.summary: 反事实解释告诉用户，删掉哪些历史行为，这条推荐就不会再出现。问题是在 MovieLens-1M 上，想把排第一的电影挤出前 5 名，往往要删掉十几到几十条看过的电影，这么长的清单用户看不出原因。作者让 LLM 当中间人，从要删的电影和其余历史里各抽一些、只给年份和类型，让它用一句话总结要删的那批有什么共同偏好。打分时要求这句话和要删的电影对得上，同时和其余历史对不上，否则就是一句对谁都成立的空话。再用 DPO 按这些分数训一轮，正确性几乎在所有设置下都提升。==解释好不好，很大程度取决于上游的反事实方法==，ACCENT 和 SPINRec 给出的删除清单最短，总结出来的话也最准。

papers.title: ShopMind: A Mental World Model for Personalized and Realistic E-commerce User Simulation
papers.authors: Peixuan Hou, Bin Chen, Li He, Jian Xu, Xiuli Ma, Guojie Song
papers.abstract: Large language models are widely used in e-commerce user simulation, providing a foundation for understanding users and predicting human decisions. However, existing simulators still struggle to achieve both personalization and behavioral realism. Most methods predict the next action directly from interaction histories and the current context, without accounting for the evolving mental world that underlies user behavior. Theory of Mind suggests that behavior is driven by mental states, including beliefs, uncertainties, and intentions. Users may interpret the same information in distinct ways, leading to divergent behaviors, while an individual's mental state evolves through interaction and shapes subsequent actions. Ignoring this process prevents simulators from faithfully capturing individual differences and realistic behavior patterns, and undermines its effectiveness in downstream applications. To address this, we propose ShopMind, a Mental World Model for e-commerce user simulation that captures how consumers interpret shopping information and how their mental states evolve, better reflecting individual users and real-world behavior patterns. We further use behavior-mental state pairs synthesized by ShopMind to train a Mental State Reconstruction (MSR) model, which infers consumers' latent mental states from observable behavior. Experiments show that ShopMind improves personalization by 18.0% and behavioral realism by 19.6% over the strongest alternatives. Moreover, MSR improves performance on consumption value measurement and CTR prediction, showing the utility of ShopMind for understanding and predicting real user behavior.
papers.summary: 用 LLM 模拟电商用户，常见做法是根据历史行为和当前页面直接预测下一步动作。可同一件打折商品，在意价格的用户看到的是机会，在意品质的用户可能觉得质量一般，光看行为记录分不出这两种人。ShopMind 给每个模拟用户维护一份随浏览更新的心理状态，记下对商品的看法、还没打消的疑虑和眼下的打算，挑下一步动作时先往后推演，再用真实轨迹训出的打分模型挑最像真人的那个。和最强基线比，个性化指标好 18.0%，整段购物轨迹的真实度好 19.6%。更有用的是副产品。用合成的成对数据训一个从行为反推心理状态的模型，加进真实淘宝日志上的 CTR 预估后 AUC 提升。==让大模型零样本直接猜心理状态，CTR 预估反而变差==。

papers.title: Clinical Evidence-Guided Residual Learning for Medication Recommendation with Dynamic DDI Regularization
papers.authors: Zesheng Li, Chengchang Pan, Honggang Qi
papers.abstract: Medication recommendation must combine patient-specific treatment evidence with the interaction structure of a prescription. The central challenge is to determine which evidence supports each medication and how strongly to regularize interactions while preserving predictive quality. We propose EviDrug, a clinical evidence-guided residual learning framework. Its clinical-memory backbone integrates a self-trained visit-aware encoder, training-case memory and one medication-set interaction block to establish a patient-specific prescription. A gated refinement head combines the backbone states with clinical associations and history-conditioned medication identities through bounded logit corrections. Drug-drug interaction (DDI) feedback adapts regularization strength using training-query predictions. Across MIMIC-IV, NWICU and SICdb, EviDrug leads twelve published-method baselines in AP, F1 and Jaccard, improving AP by 2.26, 2.06 and 1.71 percentage points over the strongest comparator. These gains come at lower parameter and runtime costs than MetaDrug. Matched controls demonstrate DDI reductions with stable predictive quality. Code is available at https://github.com/LIZESHENG13/EviDrug.
papers.summary: 用药推荐要从病历里给出一组药，常见做法是把相似病人的处方搬过来。可两个相似病人一个用了 B 和 C，一个用了 B 和 A，整张处方搬过来就会带进证据很弱的药。EviDrug 把判断落到每一种药上，先用病人自己的历史和检索到的相似病例给出初始处方，再按每种药各自的证据对分数做有上限的修正。另一处设计针对药物相互作用（DDI）的惩罚。训练中按阈值切出处方集合，统计真实的 DDI 率，每轮据此调整惩罚力度。在 MIMIC-IV 上 AP 比最强基线高 2.26 个百分点，和只训预测相比，测试集 DDI 降了 9.0%，AP 和 F1 几乎不变。==平滑的代理损失在变，按阈值选出的那组药可能根本没变==。

papers.title: Severity-Controlled Prediction Sets for Medication Recommendation
papers.authors: Yu Gu, Zijun Yu, Chi-Kuang Yeh, Xinyu Wang, Ziyang Song
papers.abstract: Medication recommendation is a multi-label prediction task. However, existing prediction-set evaluation and calibration methods rely mainly on exact-overlap metrics and therefore treat all missed medications as equally severe, overlooking how closely the prediction set matches them within the medication hierarchy. To address this, we introduce Conformal Severity Control (CSC), a post-hoc framework for calibrating medication prediction sets under hierarchy-aware mismatch severity. CSC uses the Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) hierarchy to quantify mismatch severity and controls patient-level severity without retraining the predictor, supporting both average severity and upper-quantile severity for the highest-severity mismatches. Experiments on MIMIC-IV show that CSC tracks user-specified severity tolerances and shifts prediction sets away from distant mismatches toward exact or close matches.
papers.summary: 用药推荐的评测通常只看漏没漏。漏掉一种药，不管预测集合里有没有同类的替代药，都算同样的错。CSC 借药物分类树（ATC）给每个漏掉的药打严重度，集合里有同一小类的药就罚得轻，只有分类上相距很远的药就罚满分。然后在训好的模型分数上用校准集挑一个全局阈值，让测试病人的平均严重度不超过给定的容忍度，模型不用重训。在 MIMIC-IV 上容忍度设 0.25，实测平均严重度是 0.2439。作者也写明，按分数取 top-k 并把集合大小对齐时，平均严重度反而更低。==它的用处是阈值能直接由风险容忍度定出来==，同样预算下并不挑得更准。把类目树上的近邻错误和远处错误分开算，推荐评测也能借用。

papers.title: Do Feature Interactions Break Explainability? Provable Explanations for Any-Order Neural Additive Models
papers.authors: Idan Refaeli, Yizhak Yisrael Elboher, Guy Katz, Shahaf Bassan
papers.abstract: Post-hoc explanation methods for neural networks are often heuristic and lack provable guarantees. A common alternative to such methods that was studied in recent years is to compute a cardinally-minimal subset of input features that is provably sufficient to determine the model's prediction. For general neural networks, however, finding such explanations is computationally intractable. In contrast, recent work showed that this problem becomes more tractable for a particular family of neural networks, namely neural additive models (NAMs), though standard NAMs are highly restrictive because they exclude feature interactions altogether. In this work, we study the computation of provably minimal and sufficient explanations for neural networks with restricted feature interactions, bridging the gap between fully general neural networks and purely additive models. We first prove that even with constant-order interactions, the problem is $\Sigma_2^P$-hard, implying that worst-case exponential complexity is unavoidable. We then identify two provably tractable settings: one based on sparsity in the interaction structure and another based on a stronger interaction-aware notion of sufficiency. Under either of these settings, we develop algorithms that compute provable explanations for neural networks with any-order interactions while retaining much of the computational efficiency of additive models. Empirically, we show that these explanations are significantly smaller and faster to obtain than those produced by standard algorithms, while being derived from models that achieve much higher accuracy than standard NAMs. Overall, our results help expand the class of neural networks that admit efficient provable explanations, while clarifying the fundamental role of feature interactions in shaping their complexity.
papers.summary: 解释一个预测，有一种带保证的做法是找出最少的一组特征，把它们固定住后其余特征怎么变，预测都不变。对一般神经网络这件事算不动，对完全不含特征交叉的加性模型（NAM）却很好算。作者证明，哪怕只允许固定阶数的交叉，最坏情况下就和一般神经网络一样难，需要指数次验证器调用。退路有两条，交叉结构足够稀疏、彼此重叠有限，或者换个更严格的定义、把交叉项拆开单独验证，这时都只需线性次数的调用。在九个表格数据集的二阶模型上，稀疏版本的解释都比贪心删特征的基线小，差距最大的 HELOC 上只用 21.1% 的特征，基线要 55.2%。==解释变难的根源就在特征交叉==，想要可证明的解释，交叉就得设计得稀疏。

papers.title: Can the Remaining Answers Change the Prediction? Worst-Case Stability Checks for Personalized Rating Models
papers.authors: Priyanka Siddappa, Muntaqim Ahmed Raju, Shifat Haider Al Amin, Ruizhe Ma
papers.abstract: Missing ratings can overturn a personalized model's current prediction. For completed models with additive response scores, exact worst case bounds check all missing assignments without changing the current predictor. We evaluate this audit retrospectively in two self-triage cohorts, 108 clinicians rating three simulated psychiatric interviews, and 126 counseling demonstrations annotated by ten experts. Under shared random half histories, Fisher adaptation based on observed ratings reduces log loss relative to response frequency by 0.1071 nats in the clinician audit (95% CI [0.0867,0.1261]) and 0.0223 in counseling (95% CI[0.0121,0.0321]). The counseling test excludes target experts and source videos from training. Certification covers 5.4% and 10.5% of targets; fixed width acquisition raises coverage to 13.7% and 28.6% at the same budgets. With weights and responses held fixed, the observed-rating update also has lower loss than an affine partial update while certifying exactly the same evaluated targets. The certificate establishes agreement with the completed model, not correctness or stability at intermediate updates. These rating tasks test the method; clinical usefulness remains untested.
papers.summary: 个性化打分模型常要在用户只答了一部分题时先给预测，比如根据一位医生已给的一半症状评分，预测其余条目。问题是，剩下没答的那些会不会把当前预测翻过来？作者借了选举唱票的思路，领先者在剩余选票怎么分配下都赢，就可以提前宣布。只要完整模型对每条回答的贡献是相加的，每条缺失回答各自取最坏情况就能算出精确下界，不用枚举组合。在 108 位医生的评分数据上，有一半历史时能这样确认的预测只有 5.4%。先补那些最能收窄最坏情况的回答，同样预算下升到 13.7%。==确认的只是和补全后的模型一致，并不等于预测正确==。这类证书适合用来决定什么时候可以停止追问。
